_comment: Label map for eval/evaluate.py. A directory name in the evaluation set must
appear here or the evaluation refuses to run: labels are never guessed.
'modelClass' is the exact class name the registered model emits. When it is
null the directory holds a condition this model cannot name, and those images
are reported as an out-of-distribution probe (abstention behaviour) rather

cotton.labelSource: ClassLabel feature names read from the parquet file's HuggingFace metadata
cotton.overlapWarning: This dataset's provenance relative to the cotton model's (unnamed) training data is unknown. Treat these numbers as a sanity check, not as field performance.

herbicide-growth-damage.note: Not a class of the cotton model; used to probe whether unsupported conditions are reported with false confidence.

leaf-hopper-jassids.note: A pest, not a class of this model. The model must never be presented as detecting pests.

leaf-redding.note: A physiological/nutritional condition, not a class of this model.

leaf-variegation.note: Not a class of this model.

soybean.license: No licence declared on the dataset card. Downloaded on demand by the operator for local verification and not redistributed with this project.
soybean.labelSource: ClassLabel feature names read from the parquet file's HuggingFace metadata
soybean.overlapWarning: The soybean model card states its own held-out photos came from its training datasets. This dataset is a separate small public set, but its provenance relative to LeafNet is not documented, so overlap cannot be excluded.

bacterial-blight.note: The soybean model has no bacterial-disease class; used to probe false confidence on unsupported conditions.
